Name: WalkAndRun
Description:
[b]简介[/b]
Walk & Run 把角色的移动拆成「走路」和「跑步」两种速度：一个走路倍率、一个跑步倍率，随时用按键组合切换，两档速度都可以自己调。
走路适合浇水、种田、下矿这类需要精细操作的场合，跑步适合跑图赶路。跑步时角色会使用星露谷自带的跑步动画帧，动画播放速度也会跟着跑步倍率一起加快，脚步不会和移动速度脱节。
所有东西都可以配置：切换键、两个速度倍率、是否启用跑步动画、切换提示、启动时的默认模式，以及骑马时是否也应用倍率。
[b]安装方法[/b]
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI 4.0 或更高版本：[url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io[/url][/*]
[*]下载本模组，把压缩包里的 
[code]WalkAndRun[/code] 文件夹解压到 
[code]星露谷/Mods[/code] 目录[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏[/*]
[/list]可选：安装 Generic Mod Config Menu，就能在游戏内「设置 → 模组选项 → Walk & Run」里修改所有选项。
[b]主要功能[/b]
[list]
[*]走路 / 跑步两种移动速度，各有独立倍率（1.0 = 原版走路速度）[/*]
[*]切换键可自定义：默认 Shift + Ctrl，游戏内可改成任意按键或组合键[/*]
[*]使用游戏自带的跑步动画，动画速度与跑步倍率同步[/*]
[*]切换时左上角提示当前模式（可关闭）[/*]
[*]可选支持 Generic Mod Config Menu，提供速度滑块和按键编辑器[/*]
[*]中英文文本，跟随游戏语言[/*]
[*]只影响自己的角色：剧情事件、骑马（默认）和其他玩家都不受影响[/*]
[*]随时可添加或移除，不会修改存档数据[/*]
[/list][b]前置需求[/b]
[list]
[*]星露谷 1.6.x（在 1.6.15 上验证）[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 或更高版本（在 4.5.2 上验证）：[url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io[/url][/*]
[*]可选：Generic Mod Config Menu（用于游戏内菜单）：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098[/url][/*]
[*]不需要其他框架或内容包[/*]
[/list][b]兼容性说明[/b]
[list]
[*]会乘移动速度的模组（例如 bcmpinc 的「Movement Speed」）会和本模组叠加，请禁用它们或把倍率改成 1.0[/*]
[*]本模组接管了原版自带的奔跑逻辑（Shift 奔跑键和「自动奔跑」选项），速度完全由本模组控制[/*]
[*]Windows 下 Ctrl+Shift 也是输入法切换快捷键，如果冲突可以把切换键改成别的[/*]
[/list][b]致谢[/b]
感谢星露谷模组社区、SMAPI 作者 Pathoschild，以及 Generic Mod Config Menu 作者 spacechase0。


[b]Description[/b]
Walk & Run splits your farmer's movement into two speeds: a walking speed and a running speed. Switch between them at any time with a key combination, and tune both speeds to your liking.
Walking is comfortable for precision work — watering, planting, mining — while running is for crossing the map. In running mode the farmer uses Stardew Valley's own run animation frames, and the animation speed follows your running multiplier, so the feet stay in sync with the movement.
Everything is configurable: the toggle key, both speed multipliers, whether to use the run animation, the on-screen message, the starting mode, and whether the multiplier also applies while riding a horse.
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0 or later: [url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io[/url][/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the 
[code]WalkAndRun[/code] folder into your 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/*]
[/list]Optionally install Generic Mod Config Menu to edit everything in-game via Settings → Mod Options → Walk & Run.
[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*]Walking and running speeds, each with its own multiplier (1.0 = vanilla walking speed)[/*]
[*]Configurable toggle key: Shift + Ctrl by default, change it to any key or key combination in-game[/*]
[*]Uses the game's own run animation, with the animation speed synced to your running multiplier[/*]
[*]On-screen message when switching modes (can be disabled)[/*]
[*]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support with speed sliders and a keybind editor[/*]
[*]English and Chinese text, following your game language[/*]
[*]Only affects your own farmer: events, horse riding (by default) and other players are untouched[/*]
[*]Safe to add or remove at any time; no save data is modified[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x (tested on 1.6.15)[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later (tested on 4.5.2): [url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io[/url][/*]
[*]Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu (in-game menu): [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098[/url][/*]
[*]No other frameworks or content packs are needed[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Speed mods that multiply movement speed (e.g. bcmpinc's "Movement Speed") stack with this mod. Disable them or set their multiplier to 1.0[/*]
[*]This mod takes over the game's built-in run handling (the Shift run key and the "auto-run" option) so that its own walk/run toggle is the only thing controlling your speed[/*]
[*]On Windows, Ctrl+Shift is also the input-method switch shortcut; change the toggle key if that bothers you[/*]
[/list][b]Shout outs[/b]
Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community, to Pathoschild for SMAPI, and to spacechase0 for Generic Mod Config Menu.
